mapper.sql: t.term_id, t.term_code, t.term_name, t.start_date, t.end_date, t.status, t.is_current, t.created_at, t.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course c WHERE c.semester = t.term_code) AS course_count
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM academic_term t
AND (t.term_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.term_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND t.status = #{status}
ORDER BY t.is_current DESC, t.start_date DESC, t.term_code DESC
SELECT FROM academic_term t WHERE t.status != 'ARCHIVED' OR t.is_current = 1 ORDER BY t.is_current DESC, t.start_date DESC, t.term_code DESC
SELECT FROM academic_term t WHERE t.is_current = 1 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO academic_term (term_code, term_name, start_date, end_date, status, is_current, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{termCode}, #{termName}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{status}, #{current}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE academic_term SET term_code = #{termCode}, term_name = #{termName}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE term_id = #{termId}
UPDATE academic_term SET is_current = 0, status = CASE WHEN status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 'ARCHIVED' ELSE status END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE is_current = 1 OR status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course WHERE semester = #{termCode}
